scenes.title: Privacy
scenes.caption: What Pixel Reel keeps. It is not much.
scenes.say: Here is what Pixel Reel keeps, in plain words. It won't take long, because it isn't much.

scenes.title: Your reel
scenes.caption: The scenes, the recordings, and the video if you ask.
scenes.say: It keeps your reel. That is the scenes Claude sends, the recordings of my voice, and the video, if you ask for one.

scenes.title: Nothing about you
scenes.caption: No accounts. No names. No email addresses.
scenes.say: It keeps nothing about you. There are no accounts, so there are no names, and no email addresses.

scenes.title: One small count
scenes.caption: It counts requests by internet address, for a day at most.
scenes.say: One small thing. To stop anyone making too many reels, it counts requests by internet address. That count is never written down, and it is gone within a day.

scenes.title: For 30 days
scenes.caption: Then it is deleted. Or sooner, if you ask.
scenes.say: Reels are deleted after thirty days. Or ask Claude to delete one, and it is gone at once.

scenes.title: Who can see it
scenes.caption: Anyone with the link. So mind who you send it to.
scenes.say: Anyone with the link can watch a reel. Links are long and random, so nobody can guess one. But do mind who you send it to.

scenes.title: Nobody else
scenes.caption: Your words are not sent to a voice company.
scenes.say: And the voice is made by Pixel Reel itself. Your words are not sent to a voice company.
